facts.fact: Decree n°2022-0639/PT-RM of 3 November 2022, instituting the biometric national identity card, cites Law n°06-040 of 11 August 2006 (the NINA law) among the texts it rests on, as a law in force at that date; the document is itself a decree, not a law.
facts.system: Loi n°06-040 du 11 août 2006 portant institution du Numéro d'Identification Nationale (NINA)

facts.fact: Decree n°2022-0639/PT-RM of 3 November 2022, made citing Law n°06-040 and its 2006 decree, requires the NINA number for any first or renewed biometric ID card application, which police, gendarmerie and sub-prefects issue; it also states the card replaces the NINA card by right.
facts.system: Loi n°06-040 du 11 août 2006 portant institution du Numéro d'Identification Nationale (NINA)

systems.owner: Ministre chargé de la Sécurité (Ministère de la Sécurité et de la Protection civile)
systems.tiers: Police commissioners, gendarmerie brigade commanders, sub-prefects; diplomatic and consular missions abroad
Carried on the biometric card; required to apply for it
